verdict.rationale: Qodo explicitly documents on-prem/self-managed deployment ('Deploy Qodo entirely within your own infrastructure', a dedicated on-prem deployment guide, and a deployment-model support table listing single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped options), directly satisfying the self-hosting story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that self-hosted deployments work as documented, and more detail on infrastructure requirements/limitations of the self-hosted mode.
